name: Grindstone wheel
description: A thick sandstone wheel about 0.65 m across on an iron axle, turning in a timber frame of two rails on four splayed legs, with an iron crank and a wooden grip at the front and the bottom of the wheel dipping into a plank trough of water.

provenance.prompt: A sandstone wheel in a timber frame with a crank and a water trough, about 1 × 0.5 × 1 m.
